summary: Her hook names a method in caps (THE LOVE LETTER METHOD, THEY NEED ME METHOD). A named method feels like a thing you can save and try tonight.
The promise is one big outcome and a speed: get them obsessed, manifest a text instantly, overnight. Her biggest-liked posts (about 1.6M likes each, per search snippets) are this shape.
Save bait is built into the hook: repeat these for 7 days, listen three times. The instruction is the reason to save.
She replies to comments on camera (Replying to @...) and treats haters as fuel for the algorithm.

Her best-converting Stella format: she reads a list of affirmations fast, a guy off camera says "How can I remember all these?", and the app is the answer. She credits it with most of Stella's signups.
She puts the app inside her strongest niche instead of making ads, and says demos that show the app working convert better than videos that only mention it.
She remakes her own past hits again and again, and mines comments for what to build next. Stella grew out of a ChatGPT 'future self' prompt video.
Her founder story (revenue, building with Claude Code, spite as fuel) lives in interviews, not her own short videos. That's the gap an Align founder page can own.
forAlign: Keep her shapes, never her lines. The studio carries over the hook type and format; every word is about Align.
Lead with a named Align method: the face-last method, the sealed-answer method. Then show it working in the app. Show beats tell.
Use her interruption skit with a friend off camera: you rattle off the questions you should ask on a first date, they say "how am I supposed to ask all that", you play a talk card.
Reply to the real comments you get (no photos will never work, astrology is fake) with a screen recording as the receipt.
Do the founder story she only tells in interviews, in short form: built with an AI, what's real and what's seeded, the bar pays for the date.
No made-up numbers. Where a hook wants a number you don't have yet, it's a [bracket] until you do.
Film in batches: promote the best take of each reel, schedule three or four for one morning, and use the teleprompter.
